prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a read-only `stats` command that reports total, pending, completed, and completion percentage rounded to one decimal using invariant formatting. Also report counts created on each UTC calendar date, ordered ascending; empty storage must produce zeros and an empty date list. Support `--json` with stable property names and types, and ensure the command never rewrites storage. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/stats.txt` and integrate it so non-JSON statistics display the banner before the dashboard, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `STATS`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+        'stats' {
+            Assert-KnownOptions -Options $options -Allowed @('data-file', 'json')
+            $tasks = @(Read-TaskStore -Path $dataFile)
+            $total = $tasks.Count
+            $completed = @($tasks | Where-Object { [string]$_.status -eq 'completed' }).Count
+            $pending = @($tasks | Where-Object { [string]$_.status -eq 'pending' }).Count
+
+            $percent = if ($total -eq 0) {
+                [double]0
+            }
+            else {
+                [math]::Round((([double]$completed / [double]$total) * 100), 1, [System.MidpointRounding]::AwayFromZero)
+            }
+
+            $dates = foreach ($task in $tasks) {
+                $property = $task.PSObject.Properties['createdAt']
+                if ($null -eq $property -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$property.Value)) {
+                    continue
+                }
+                $parsed = [System.DateTimeOffset]::Parse(
+                    [string]$property.Value,
+                    [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture,
+                    [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind)
+                $parsed.UtcDateTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
+            }
+
+            $byDate = @(
+                @($dates) | Group-Object | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object {
+                    [pscustomobject][ordered]@{ date = [string]$_.Name; count = [int]$_.Count }
+                }
+            )
+
+            $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                total = [int]$total
+                pending = [int]$pending
+                completed = [int]$completed
+                completionPercentage = [double]$percent
+                byDate = $byDate
+            }
+
+            if ($asJson) {
+                Write-TaskForgeOutput -Value $summary -AsJson $true
+            }
+            else {
+                $percentText = ([double]$percent).ToString('0.0', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
+                $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/stats.txt'
+                $output = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
+                if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bannerPath) {
+                    foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath)) {
+                        $output.Add($line)
+                    }
+                }
+                $output.Add("Total: $total")
+                $output.Add("Pending: $pending")
+                $output.Add("Completed: $completed")
+                $output.Add("Completion: $percentText%")
+                $output.Add('By date:')
+                if ($byDate.Count -eq 0) {
+                    $output.Add('  (none)')
+                }
+                else {
+                    foreach ($entry in $byDate) {
+                        $output.Add("  $($entry.date): $($entry.count)")
+                    }
+                }
+                $output -join "`n"
+            }
+        }

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- stats command tests (fixture-owned) ---
    $statsData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats.json'

    $statsEmpty = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($statsEmpty.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats should succeed on empty storage'
    $emptyReport = $statsEmpty.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($emptyReport.total -eq 0 -and $emptyReport.pending -eq 0 -and $emptyReport.completed -eq 0) 'empty stats should report zero counts'
    Assert-True ($emptyReport.completionPercentage -eq 0.0) 'empty stats completion percentage should be 0.0'
    Assert-True (@($emptyReport.byDate).Count -eq 0) 'empty stats should produce an empty date list'
    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statsData)) 'stats must not create storage (read-only)'

    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'One', '--data-file', $statsData) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Two', '--data-file', $statsData) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Three', '--data-file', $statsData) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $statsData) | Out-Null

    $before = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($statsData)
    $statsJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsData, '--json')
    $after = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($statsData)
    Assert-True ($statsJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats should succeed on populated storage'
    Assert-True ($before -eq $after) 'stats must not rewrite storage (read-only)'
    $report = $statsJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($report.total -eq 3 -and $report.pending -eq 2 -and $report.completed -eq 1) 'stats should report accurate counts'
    Assert-True ($report.completionPercentage -eq 33.3) 'stats completion percentage should round to one decimal'
    $today = [System.DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.UtcDateTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
    Assert-True (@($report.byDate).Count -eq 1) 'byDate should contain one UTC calendar date'
    Assert-True ($report.byDate[0].date -eq $today -and $report.byDate[0].count -eq 3) 'byDate should count tasks per UTC date'
    Assert-True (-not $statsJson.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'JSON stats output must be banner-free'

    $statsText = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsData)
    Assert-True ($statsText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON stats should succeed'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'non-JSON stats should display the banner before the dashboard'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.IndexOf('STATS') -lt $statsText.Output.IndexOf('Total:')) 'banner should precede the dashboard'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('Completion: 33.3%')) 'non-JSON stats should use invariant percentage formatting'

    $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/stats.txt'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bannerPath) 'assets/stats.txt should exist'
    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath)
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'banner asset should be exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (($bannerLines -join "`n").Contains('STATS')) 'banner asset should contain the literal STATS'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: all fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
